description: Create an empty group on your GrowSurf program. Add Campaign Rewards with this group's `groupId` before adding participants or rules. Omit `rules` or send an empty array; nonempty rules return `400`. Use `growsurf_update_campaign_group` to add rules after configuring rewards. Group names must be unique, ignoring case; Default is reserved. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program id for this call: the `id` returned by `growsurf_list_campaigns`, not the program name or a share URL. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name.description: The group name (internal only, never shown to participants).

rules.description: Omit or send an empty array. Add rules after configuring a reward.

type.description: `PARTICIPANT` — an existing participant ID; the participant moves in now. `EMAIL` — an exact email address. `DOMAIN` — a company domain such as `hooli.com`, which also matches its subdomains. Email and domain rules place new signups and affiliate approvals.

value.description: The participant ID, email address, or domain.

name: growsurf_create_campaign_group

outputSchema.description: A group of participants who earn their own rewards: the Campaign Rewards whose `groupId` is this group's `id`.

createdAt.description: When the group was created, in Unix milliseconds.

name.description: The group name (internal only, never shown to participants).

order.description: The group's position in the program's group list.

rules.description: The rules that place participants in this group.

value.description: The participant ID, email address, or domain.

signupCode.description: The code for this group's signup link. The link alone does not reveal private rewards. A participant who signs up with the link and verifies their identity joins the group.

updatedAt.description: When the group was last changed, in Unix milliseconds.

title: Create Campaign Group
